messages:
emma_new: hey everyone 11 first week question: my laptop came with Safari and Chrome. do we have a preferred browser for corp logins? also i clicked a link earlier in a welcome email that looked suspicious 1 should i report it somewhere?

rob_peopleops: welcome emma! :wave: we prefer Chrome for the least surprises with SSO extensions, but either is fine. if you saw a suspicious welcome mail, please forward to security@redwood.com and mark it as phishing in your client. also file the quick incident form: https://intra.redwood.local/phish-report

jess_it: re: browsers 1 make sure you install the corp Chrome profile via the MDM-managed extension pack. we'll push it during your device onboarding. if you want to switch now, don't enable profile sync to your personal Google account.

emma_new: thanks. i forwarded the email. tiny follow-up: password manager usage? should I import from my personal manager?

arjun_security: don't import corp creds into a personal password manager. we provide 1Password corp seat. request access via Okta App -> 1Password and choose the "Import" helper only after we approve. never store API keys or KMS creds in personal vaults.

vault-bot: 1Password: new-seat request queued for Emma (okta_id: emma). ETA approval: 2 business hours.

emma_new: perfect. also, phishing simulation 1 is there a training cadence i should expect as a new hire?

arjun_security: new employees are enrolled in the 14-day awareness track: simulated phish on day 3 and day 10, plus the interactive micro-training if you click anything. there's also a mandatory Secure Coding + Data Handling module to finish in 5 days. link: https://okta.learn.redwood/security-onboarding

devops-mgr: FYI, if you need local KMS testing we have a sandbox I can add you to. it's behind the dev VPC and requires MFA + SSH certs. ping me with your GitHub handle and i'll add you.

emma_new: my GitHub handle is emma-redwood. would love sandbox access for secrets-local testing.

jess_it: one more device gotcha: if you use any browser extensions (theme, grammar tools), keep them disabled until we validate them. extensions are a common vector for exfil. if you need an extension for accessibility, reach out and we'll do a quick review.

arjun_security: also enable system MFA (unlock + passkey) and finish the MFA enrollment notice from security-bot within 24h or you'll lose some app approvals.

security-bot: MFA Reminder: complete enrollment within 24 hours to avoid access interruptions.

emma_new: appreciate the checklist. i'll finish the Okta modules and ping devops-mgr for sandbox access. thanks all!

rob_peopleops: glad to help. shout here if anything blocks onboarding :slightly_smiling_face:

devops-mgr: added emma-redwood to the KMS sandbox at 1780011402. you should get an invite to the dev VPC and an ssh cert request link.

emma_new: invite received, starting the SSH cert flow now. will report back if i hit any blockers. thanks!
